LeaderAgent.name: decide_contribution
LeaderAgent.description: The leader determines the level of contribution to the public goods pool, choosing either a voluntary or forced decision-making mechanism.

output_updates.name: contribution_level
output_updates.description: The level of contribution chosen by the leader.

output_updates.name: selected_mechanism
output_updates.description: The decision mechanism used by the leader, either 'voluntary' or 'forced'.

FollowerAgent.name: adjust_contribution
FollowerAgent.description: Based on the observation of the leader's action, the follower adjusts their own contribution to the public goods pool.

required_variables.name: analyzed_contribution_level
required_variables.description: The analyzed contribution level perceived by the follower from the leader's actions.

required_variables.name: perceived_fairness
required_variables.description: The follower's perception of the fairness of the leader's contribution.

required_variables.name: perceived_intent
required_variables.description: The follower's perception of the sincerity of the leader's intent.

output_updates.name: actual_contribution
output_updates.description: The actual contribution level decided by the follower.

output_updates.name: completion_status
output_updates.description: The status of the follower's decision-making process.
